manaNeeded: {3}{W} plus the cost of the additional instant or sorcery
notablePrerequisites: You can cast an additional instant or sorcery.
description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its cost.
Stormsplitter triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
When that token enters, Spiritcall Enthusiast triggers, becoming prepared.
Resolve the instant or sorcery from step 1.
Cast a copy of Scrollboost from exile by paying {1}{W} and unpreparing Spiritcall Enthusiast.
Both Stormsplitters trigger, creating two more token copies of Stormsplitter.
When a token enters, Spiritcall Enthusiast triggers, becoming prepared.
Resolve the copy of Scrollboost, giving one or two creatures +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing one Stormsplitter token, adding {W}.
Activate any mana source, adding an additional {1}.
Cast a copy of Scrollboost from exile by paying {1}{W} and unpreparing Spiritcall Enthusiast.
At least three Stormsplitters trigger, creating at least three more token copies of Stormsplitter.
When a token enters, Spiritcall Enthusiast triggers, becoming prepared.
Resolve the copy of Scrollboost, giving one or two creatures +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing two Stormsplitter tokens, adding {W}{W}.
Repeat from step 11 any number of times.
Once you have infinite Stormsplitter tokens, you may activate Phyrexian Altar any number of times, adding infinite mana.
